# Projects

Projects group database connections and data sources. The API reads projects; create and change them in the dashboard. Authentication, pagination and errors are described in the [Overview](index.md).

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/projects` | [List projects](#get-projects) |
| `GET` | `/v1/projects/{project_id}` | [Get a project](#get-project) |

---

## List projects {: #get-projects }

```http
GET /v1/projects
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | integer | No | Maximum number of rows to return (default: 200, max: 5000) |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List projects | array of [Project](#project) |
| `400` | Invalid limit | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/projects' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```

---

## Get a project {: #get-project }

```http
GET /v1/projects/{project_id}
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | path | integer | Yes | Project ID |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Get a project | [Project](#project) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `404` | Project not found | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/projects/<project_id>' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```
